scientific_warnings: 180-degree spacecraft roll (SPS_EPA) flip detected across survey passes; all frames have been WCS-reprojected onto a common North-up, East-left TAN grid.

SPHEREx Linear Variable Filters sample a different wavelength per exposure. Compare brightness strictly within the same detector band to distinguish true variability from the star's spectral energy distribution (SED).

Wavelength difference delta_lambda > 0.05 um detected in difference maps for band(s) 6. Residual flux differences may include spectral energy distribution (SED) variation across the Linear Variable Filter.
Detector core saturation (OVERFLOW / NaN core) detected in 7/7 frames. Visual cores are reconstructed from the 98th-percentile PSF halo; astrometric centroids use halo center-of-mass.
